criterion.scope: Separate import-window Linux Chromium process-tree PSS and private-memory screen for source PR #905 against its exact base. Both metrics must satisfy the original limits on both hosts for every dictionary.
criterion.observations: Four predetermined fresh-profile imports per host, with two adjacent pairs in ABBA or BAAB order. No observations excluded, replaced, or retried based on outcomes. Failure or incomplete coverage cannot qualify.
criterion.correctness: Original production-default import, all 72 public lookup observations, restart, persistence, and every media payload must validate. Semantic receipts must match across all four observations in each cell.
criterion.timing: The browser report, benchmark summary, and all memory receipts explicitly mark instrumented timing as non-authoritative. No latency claim uses this study.
criterion.limitations: Non-atomic sampled import-window maxima, not exact peaks. Startup, semantic/media readback, and restart are excluded from maxima. Cumulative allocation or copying reductions do not establish peak-memory savings.
